subject: Landing zone decision playbook — hosting lane selection and timelines
messages:
From: Anna Morales <anna.morales@lumenhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lumen Health Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP & hosting questions for Lumen MVP

Vanessa — thanks again for the demo today. Lumen's leadership is aligned that we need a short MAP to get to a production pilot in Q1. Before we formalize the milestones, two quick things to confirm:

1) Preferred deployment modes we should evaluate (we're explicitly considering: Hosted for rapid start, Dedicated reserved capacity for steady-state latency, Private/VPC for regulated traffic). We want concrete timelines for each.
2) Region requirements: legal has flagged data residency for patient metadata — primary preference is US-West; EU only if EU customers are in scope for the pilot.

I've attached a short requirements sheet (Lumen_MVP_requirements.pdf). Can you and your team put together a MAP that lists the evaluation steps, decision gates, and suggested go/no-go dates?

Thanks — happy to sync via call if easier.

—Anna
Anna Morales
Head of Product, Lumen Health
anna.morales@lumenhealth.com
+1 415-555-0133

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Morales <anna.morales@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & hosting questions for Lumen MVP

Anna — appreciated the time. Attached is a draft MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) that breaks the plan into four milestones:

- M1 (2 weeks): Security & compliance intake — SOC2 artifacts, data flow diagram, and legal checklist.
- M2 (3 weeks): Technical POC — two parallel tracks: Hosted POC (fastest) and Dedicated POC (reserved nodes + VPC peering).
- M3 (2 weeks): Performance validation & cost run rate analysis (latency p50/p95, token cost estimates).
- M4 (1 week): Procurement & rollout runway (order dedicated capacity or enable private connection).

High-level recommendation: run the Hosted POC immediately to validate integration and prompt engineering, and stand up a parallel Dedicated POC with a small reserved pool (2x A100-equivalent) to validate latency and VPC connectivity. If the Dedicated POC meets latency SLOs and procurement timelines align, we recommend committing to Dedicated in US-West as primary for the pilot, with Hosted as burst fallback. Private on-prem would be treated as a later-stage option because of the lengthier delivery runway.

Questions for you before we lock dates:
- Legal: are there any absolute blockers on using Hosted for initial evaluation?
- Networking: will you be able to provision a transit VPC for peering or do you need us to open an L2/private connectivity request?

I've attached a network diagram stub (network-diagram-vpc-peering.png) and our suggested timeline in the MAP. Happy to review on Friday.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
O: +1 650-555-0277
Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, network-diagram-vpc-peering.png

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Anna Morales <anna.morales@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & hosting questions for Lumen MVP

Vanessa / Anna — quick technical clarifications from infra side so the MAP timelines are realistic:

- Dedicated sizing: for low-p50 and predictable p95 we recommend starting with 2x A100-equivalent reserved nodes (we can quantify with expected qps once we get typical prompt sizes).\n- VPC peering timeline: standard peering + firewall rules typically 5-7 business days if Lumen provides CIDR ranges and an engineer for the handoff; predictable if procurement isn't delaying.\n- HSM/KMS: for regulated PHI flows Lumen may want CMEK via their KMS; we support KMS integration but that adds ~2 extra weeks for testing and key rotation policy alignment.\n
If legal is okay with Hosted for the first 1–2 weeks of functional validation, we can start Hosted POC immediately and parallel the Dedicated provisioning. That keeps the critical path short.

Action: can procurement share a contact? I'll own technical kickoff and will build a short acceptance criteria doc for the POC.

—Karthik
Head, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Anna Morales <anna.morales@lumenhealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lumenhealth.com, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 11:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & hosting questions for Lumen MVP

Thanks — procurement here (procurement@lumenhealth.com) will be the contact for dedicated capacity ordering. A couple notes from legal/procurement: 

- SOC2 snapshot is required for our audit; can you attach the SOC2 package?
- Data residency: primary must be US-West for pilot; EU only for future expansion (so an EU sandbox is fine for tests but not production).
- Procurement prefers an initial 3-month reserved commitment for Dedicated with an option to convert to 12-month if performance and cost look good.

We're comfortable with Hosted for the first 10 business days of functional validation as long as PHI fields are tokenized (we will provide a tokenization spec). We'll share procurement PO contact info by EOD.

—Anna Morales
Head of Product, Lumen Health
anna.morales@lumenhealth.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Morales <anna.morales@lumenhealth.com>, procurement@lumenhealth.com
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & hosting questions for Lumen MVP — commitment path

Great — thanks for the clarity. Summary & agreed next steps (finalizing MAP and milestones):

- Decision: Pilot deployment mode = Dedicated (US-West) with Hosted as burst/fallback; EU sandbox available for non-prod tests.
- Timeline:
  • Week 0 (this week): sign MAP and share tokenization spec.
  • Week 1–2: Hosted functional POC (integration, end-to-end flows) + start Dedicated provisioning request (CIDR, contacts).
  • Week 3–4: Dedicated POC run (latency validation, KV cache warmup, failover testing).
  • Week 5: Performance sign-off and procurement completes 3-month reserved order (Deal DEC-2026-045).

- Security artifacts: attached SOC2 snapshot (SOC2-snapshot-2026Q3.pdf). We will provide the full bundle to your legal via secure link; Redwood supports CMEK for Dedicated if you want to enable KMS.

- Owners: Vanessa (commercial MAP), Karthik (technical POC), Marissa (customer success onboarding), Sean (billing / procurement liaison).

Next meeting: Thursday 10am PT for kickoff. I'll update the HubSpot deal and attach the finalized MAP (link below).

Thanks all — look forward to getting this moving quickly.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2026Q3.pdf
Links: https://hubspot.example/deal/DEC-2026-045
